The '''EnhanceScan general purpose scanner''' is a multipurpose [[Portable scanner/Legends|portable scanner]] that combined several individual [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] into one unit. It was manufactured by [[CryonCorp/Legends|CryonCorp]].

==Description==
The EnhanceScan was a multipurpose [[Portable scanner/Legends|portable scanner]] manufactured by [[CryonCorp/Legends|CryonCorp]]. It was an improved model of CryonCorp's [[Lifedetec bioscanner]], adding several functions that had not been present in the previous design. The scanner had four different scanner modes; [[Bioscan/Legends|bioscanner]], [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensor]], [[metal detector]], and communications scanner. The EnhanceScan's screen displayed data relevant to the specific mode that the scanner was in at the time, and always showed specific locations and movement.<ref name="EGWT" />

The EnhanceScan incorporated a bioscanner module, capable of detecting life-forms at ranges up to 1,500 [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. Templates containing the data of over three hundred different creatures could be pre-loaded into the EnhanceScan, allowing the unit to identify life-forms by comparing its readings to the data stored in the memory banks. In this mode, the display screen would show the shape and vital statistics of any creature detected.<ref name="EGWT" />

An in-built motion sensor module detected any movement in a five hundred meter radius from the EnhanceScan. The unit could be set as a automated sentry, programmed to sound an alarm when it detected movement. A metal detector with a range of one hundred meters scanned for concentrations of metals and could be configured to search for specific ones.<ref name="EGWT" />

The communications scanner intercepted all [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] transmissions that were sent on standard frequencies within a range of three [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]]. The unit itself was incapable of transmitting messages.<ref name="EGWT" />

The EnhanceScan was powered by six rechargeable [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] which could provide enough energy for up to ten [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of operation. The unit had [[Dataport/Legends|dataports]] that allowed the EnhanceScan to be connected to computers, [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]], and [[Droid/Legends|droids]] for the exchanging of data.<ref name="EGWT" />

==History==
The EnhanceScan was favored by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], and was used on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], [[Arbra/Legends|Arbra]], and [[Thila/Legends|Thila]].
